notes.title: Big Update Incoming: New UI, Legendary Cabinet Member & Public Demo!
notes.content:
[p]Hello Chat

It's been a little while since our last update, but rest assured we've been busy cooking up exciting new features for [i]Majulah[/i]![/p][p]We've added plenty of new buildings and quirky Cabinet Members, along with a complete refresh of our game's UI to make your city-building adventures even smoother. But that's not all, we've got something special on the horizon:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340409/98b6c4d605beecd685ef587d30ae215d3dfe7dbe.png"][/img][/p][p]Meet the mysterious Cabinet Member inspired by the legendary folklore of [b]Kusu Island[/b]. 🌴✨ We won't give away too much just yet, but let's just say this member might unlock an entirely new way to build your city!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340409/7dfb4160ebd7a207243242270ce4f2970ee53d97.png"][/img][/p][p]Also, exciting news: we'll be showcasing a demo at [b]SCAPE's Re:Play 2025[/b] event from [b]1–3 August[/b]. If you're in the area, come say hi and grab yourself some exclusive holographic Cabinet Member cards!  [/p][p]And finally stay tuned, because later this month we'll be launching our [b]first full public demo[/b]! 🎉

As always, thanks so much for your ongoing support, we can't wait to see you at SCAPE and hear your feedback on all these exciting updates![/p][p]
Warmly, Khairul & Arya
[i]That One Time I Made A Game Studio[/i][/p]

notes.title: 🎉 Majulah Closed Beta Announced! | May 1–4, 2025 🎉
notes.content:
Hello Chat!

We're excited to officially announce the Closed Beta for Majulah, our city builder roguelike inspired by Singaporean culture and governance!

🗓️ Beta Dates:
May 1 (10AM SGT) to May 4, 2025

Originally planned to coincide with the Labour Day weekend, we were pleasantly surprised to find out it also lands on Singapore’s General Election polling weekend!
Considering Majulah is all about building cities, managing quirky Cabinet Members, and securing re-election through Support—well, the timing couldn’t be more perfect. 🗳️😉

🕹️ What to Expect:

Strategic city building across randomized layouts

Unique Cabinet Members with powerful combo effects

A scoring system that rewards creativity and adaptability

A fresh, roguelike twist on traditional builders

🎟️ Want to Play?
Join our mailing list to get access:
👉 http://subscribepage.io/DfygO0

Steam Beta keys will be distributed only to mailing list members—don’t miss out!

📣 We’ll be collecting feedback throughout the beta to help polish the game for launch. Be part of shaping Majulah and let your voice be heard!

Thanks for your support, and see you at the polls (both digital and real)! 🇸🇬
– The Team at That One Time I Made A Game Studio

notes.title: Majulah Joins The Days of Ramadan Festival!
notes.content:
Hello Chat!

We have exciting news—Majulah is officially part of The Days of Ramadan Festival 2025, running from Feb 28 – Mar 31! 🎉 A huge thank you to @SEAGamethetic for including us in this incredible event celebrating culture and games!

But that’s not all—we’re also introducing a new way to understand your Cabinet Members at a glance with Rarity Colors!

[h1]Cabinet Member Rarity Colors[/h1]
Your Parliament is about to get even more strategic! Each Cabinet Member now has a rarity color, making it easier to spot their power level and impact on your city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340409/eb89bdd6f406f875400044952dca2572f744c784.png[/img]

🟢 Common (Green/Blue) – Reliable, foundational members that provide steady benefits.
🔹 Example: Team Leader – Grants Support the more Cabinet Members you have.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340409/664835b49b7b6bb08e361bd6d0cc0a3757b729fc.png[/img]

🟣 Uncommon (Purple/Red) – Special abilities that reward clever city planning.
🔹 Example: 4 of a Kind – Multiplies Support by 4x if a district has exactly 4 building types.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340409/ae46ffcdd3f66d126d4edf7a1898401d6c105969.png[/img]

🟡 Rare (Gold) – High-impact members that can turn the tide of your governance.
🔹 Example: Completionist – Every district with all grids used grants a 5x multiplier to support

Could there be an even rarer tier waiting to be revealed? Some secrets take time to uncover... 

We can’t wait for you to try out these new strategic layers while playing Majulah! Thank you for your support, and don’t forget to check out the Ramadan Festival on Steam to discover more incredible games:

🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45022621/sale/RamadanFestival2025

notes.title: What Happens When You Run Out Of Space In The City To Build More Buildings?
notes.content:
Hello Chat!

A new year has rolled since our last update, and we hope your 2025 is off to a fantastic start! As we continue developing [i]Majulah[/i], we’re excited to share a feature that ties perfectly into the spirit of fresh starts and new beginnings: [b]the Demolition Mechanic[/b]!

[h2]Demolition Mechanic:[/h2]

Sometimes, progress means tearing down the old to make way for the new, and in [i]Majulah[/i], strategic demolition can unlock smarter city layouts and game-changing advantages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340409/c86bfd5367970d22455326abbfdf4b6915e24ebe.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]Clear out buildings to free up land for better placement.
[*]Demolition costs money - so do it wisely!
[/list]
[h3]Meet the Cabinet Members That Make Demolition Work For You[/h3]
To take full advantage of this feature, we've got two powerful Cabinet Members who work beautifully together:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340409/a8a4c66acc42b130bb4e74111920d0864a7d56da.png[/img]
🟣 Wrecking Ball
[list]
[*]Demolishing buildings is [b]completely free[/b], letting you reshape your city without any penalties.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340409/10b42e6bf3746490476c493b5ef0a4013ee8d903.png[/img]
🟡 Demolition Man 
[list]
[*]Grants [b]Support[/b] that scales with the number of buildings you demolish, making your demolitions even more rewarding!
[/list]
[b]Pro Tip[/b]: Combine [b]Wrecking Ball[/b]'s free demolitions with [b]Demolition Man[/b]’s scaling support for a demolition spree that will leave your city in top shape!

We’re excited to see how you’ll use this new mechanic to optimize your city layouts and grow your thriving metropolis. Keep your feedback coming, and don’t forget to share how you plan to demolish and rebuild your way to success! 

🔗 Follow us on BlueSky for more updates: [url=https://bsky.app/profile/totimags.bsky.social] @totimags.bsky.social [/url]

For next month's update, we'd like you to tell us whether you want to hear more about future building types or more of our wacky cast of Cabinet Members!

Warmly,
Khairul & Arya
That One Time I Made A Game Studio

notes.title: Majulah Joins The Battle!
notes.content:
Hello, Chat!

We’re incredibly excited to share Majulah with you, the debut game from our small studio, That One Time I Made A Game Studio. As Singaporeans, we wanted to create something that reflects our country’s unique culture, history, and architecture—something we think deserves to be shared with the world.

In Majulah, you’ll take on the role of a leader, building a thriving Singapore, making important decisions, and navigating the challenges of governance, all while creating a beautiful and functional city inspired by our home. Every playthrough is different, with new strategies, buildings, and Cabinet Members to unlock, keeping each session fresh and exciting.

We’d love to hear your thoughts and feedback as we continue to develop Majulah. Your support means the world to us, and we can’t wait to make this game even better with your help. Wishlist Majulah today, and join us on this exciting journey.

Thank you for your support—we can’t wait to let you see what we build!

Warmly,
Khairul & Arya
That One Time I Made A Game Studio
